stem.text: An addition polymer is made from monomer Z.

stem.label: monomer Z
stem.alt: Structure of monomer Z, labelled monomer Z: CH2=CH–C(=O)–OCH2CH3, an ethyl ester with a C=C double bond.

stem.text: What is the structure of the polymer made from this monomer?

A.alt: Bracketed repeat unit [CH=CH–C(=O)]n with a bond drawn out at each end.

B.alt: Bracketed repeat unit [CH=CH–C(=O)–O]n with a bond drawn out at each end.

C.alt: Bracketed repeat unit [CH2–CH=C(OCH2CH3)–O]n with a bond drawn out at each end.

D.alt: Bracketed repeat unit [CH2–CH(C(=O)OCH2CH3)]n with a bond drawn out at each end.
